notes.title: Wolfskin's Curse - Official Soundtrack Release
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43041785/0fe5d5a9a9e5e18f32718510c5b0d43e148aef39.jpg[/img]

Thanks to Luis Guerrero’s hard work, the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2693030/Wolfskins_Curse_Official_Game_Soundtrack/]Wolfskin’s Curse: Official Game Soundtrack[/url] is now available and features the combined efforts of Luis “RunnerGuitar” Guerrero, Octa Savinelli, and Ford Audio Design. A special shout-out to Block57, who assisted in confirming the waveforms and MP3/FLAC metadata was correct.

The Steam version is complementary (that means free!) and is available either in either high-quality MP3 or as 24-bit FLAC.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43041785/91454631e17db130ca5afe45ab32bc931a8b2e3d.png[/img]

If you'd like the FLAC version, please go to the "Music" tab under settings in the Steam client, then choose "download high quality audio files". That will begin downloading FLAC variants for any soundtrack you own, including ours.

If you just want the MP3s, you don't have to do anything, as they are included by default.

Thank you for all who have supported the game, as well as those who are just discovering it, and stay tuned for more projects in the future from Studio Tamafry.

Jordan
Studio Tamafry

notes.title: Wolfskin's Curse - Version 2.1

- Added little wolf icons for the history feature. Now, you need only tap the wolf icon on the "history" screen to replay any line at will!
